scope.full_target:
Let \(p\) be any prime, \(K\) any field of characteristic \(p\), and
\(\lambda\) an integer with \(0\leq\lambda<p\).
Let \(V(\lambda)\) be the complex irreducible highest-weight
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb C)\)-module of highest weight \(\lambda\),
of dimension \(\lambda+1\). Its Chevalley generators satisfy

\[
[h,x]=2x,\qquad[h,y]=-2y,\qquad[x,y]=h.
\]

Choose a nonzero highest-weight vector \(v\) with \(xv=0\) and
\(hv=\lambda v\). Let \(U_{\mathbb Z}\) be the integer subalgebra of
the universal enveloping algebra generated by all divided powers
\(X_r=x^r/r!\), \(Y_r=y^r/r!\), for integers \(r\geq0\).
An **admissible lattice** \(M\subset V(\lambda)\) is a free abelian
subgroup with an integer basis that is also a complex basis, stable under
\(U_{\mathbb Z}\). It is arbitrary, not necessarily the minimal lattice.

Put \(V(K)=M\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\). The Lie algebra
\(L(K)=(\mathbb Zx+\mathbb Zy+\mathbb Zh)\otimes_{\mathbb Z}K\)
acts by the induced lattice operators. This is the Chevalley
\(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) construction also in characteristic 2.
Prove that \(V(K)\) is nonzero and every \(K\)-linear subspace
invariant under \(x,y,h\) is zero or all of \(V(K)\).
Both \(\lambda=0\) and \(p=2\) are included; \(K\) need not be
algebraically closed.

hypotheses.statement: p is a prime integer, K is a field of characteristic p, and λ is an integer with 0≤λ<p.
V=V(λ) is the complex irreducible highest-weight sl2(C)-module of highest weight λ and of complex dimension λ+1.
The Chevalley generators satisfy [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=-2y and [x,y]=h, both in sl2(C) and in the action on V.
v∈V is nonzero, xv=0 and hv=λv.

M⊆V is an arbitrary admissible lattice: it is a free abelian subgroup possessing an integer basis that is also a complex basis of V, and it is stable under U_Z. No equality with the minimal lattice is assumed.

source.statement: V_K is nonzero, and for every K-linear subspace W⊆V_K, if x_K(W)⊆W, y_K(W)⊆W and h_K(W)⊆W, then W={0} or W=V_K. Thus V(K) is irreducible as an L_K-module, for every field K of characteristic p and every integer 0≤λ<p, including λ=0 and p=2.

correspondence.explanation: All p:ℕ with p.Prime correspond exactly to the source prime integers; lam remains an arbitrary integer constrained by H001, and K is an arbitrary field with CharP K p. V is an arbitrary complex vector space carrying the sl2 generator action: the three endomorphisms with H003 extend uniquely along the standard sl2 basis to the original Lie action, and restriction recovers them. H002 records the original dimension, irreducibility and highest-weight condition; H004 records exactly the chosen nonzero highest-weight vector. H005 keeps an arbitrary full free integer lattice, with generator stability equivalent in both directions to U_Z stability. M as a ℤ-submodule is exactly its additive subgroup. The canonical tensor flip m⊗c↦c⊗m identifies the source V(K) with VK=K⊗ℤM in both directions and intertwines the induced operators on pure tensors. Under the Stable facts proved from H005 (and h=xy−yx), latticeOp has no fallback branch and kop acts by c⊗m↦c⊗fm, hence represents the exact source x_K,y_K,h_K; N005 proves their brackets, preserving the Chevalley action also at p=2. Nontrivial VK means the vector space is nonzero. Submodule K VK ranges over every K-linear subspace, Inv is generator invariance, and ⊥/⊤ mean zero/all. These statements transport in both directions through the tensor flip, so the entire universally quantified target is equivalent, including lam=0, p=2 and fields K without algebraic closure.
